title: Her Side Effects Escape The Lab — Part 4

series.summary: Kusuri's experiments spread to the rest of the girlfriends: Hakari sniffing the ground, rabbit ears on Shizuka, Nano's hair binding Rentarou. Kusuri just keeps brewing.

segments.voiceover_text: The potions do not stay in the lab. Hakari ends up crouched on the ground, sniffing the air like an animal, while Kusuri throws a proud thumbs up. Nobody asked for this.
Shizuka sprouts rabbit ears. Rentarou touches one and she nearly detonates from embarrassment, hiding behind her phone. Kusuri's side effects are getting louder by the hour.
Nano's hair wraps around Rentarou like rope and he is helpless. Behind them, Kusuri is already cradling a fistful of fresh green tubes. She has learned absolutely nothing from any of this.
